Applied Intuition is redefining vehicle intelligence across commercial and defense sectors. As a
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Software Engineer: Build Your Own Project with AI Tools**
Bring a real coding project you care about and keep developing it with an AI coding assistant. We cover the token costs, and your project and code stay entirely yours.
  
  
This contract role is designed for engineers who have real side projects or independent work in progress and want to advance them while contributing to AI training — fully remote, on their own schedule.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Share a GitHub repository for a project you own and are actively working on
* Keep developing it in your own environment using an AI coding assistant in your terminal
* While you code, you'll occasionally be asked to choose the best of the responses the AI gives you
* We keep those preference answers; you keep everything you build

**What We're Looking For**

* Hands-on software engineering experience in any language or stack
* A substantial project of your own on GitHub (not a tutorial, template, or to-do app)
* Comfort working in the terminal and with Git
* Clear judgment about code quality, correctness, and good engineering trade-offs

**Why Join Us**

* Work on your own codebase — not someone else's
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task-based work
* Gain firsthand experience shaping how AI coding tools learn and improve
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch
